title: FireweaveDecision
description: Canonical flag evaluation decision produced by BackendAdapter / FireweaveRuntime. Mapped to OpenFeature ResolutionDetails at the provider boundary. No PostHog types.

value.description: Resolved value. On error paths this MUST be the caller-supplied default.

reason.description: OpenFeature reason (open string). Prefer standard reasons.

flagMetadata.description: OF flagMetadata: string keys → bool | string | number. Fireweave enrichment uses fireweave.* keys.

payload.description: JSON payload associated with the flag variant, if any.

emitted.description: Whether an exposure side effect was emitted for this evaluation.

suppressed.description: True when caller requested sendExposure=false or payload-only path.

oneOf.description: Cross-language int flags are reliable within ±(2^53−1).

standardMetadataKeys.description: Recommended fireweave.* metadata keys. Vendor-metadata gating (orchestrator ruling 11, ratified): `fireweave.vendorFlagId` and `fireweave.reasonCode` are emitted only when the backend reports BOTH a vendor flag id AND a condition index for the evaluation; if either is absent, NEITHER key is emitted.

fireweave.backend.description: Union across all SDK languages. `posthog` is reported only by a language still shipping the direct vendor adapter (Python, Go); the Node SDK dropped it in v3 (docs/adr/0006).

fireweave.vendorFlagId.description: Backend vendor flag id. Gated per ruling 11: emitted only together with fireweave.reasonCode, and only when the backend reported both a vendor flag id and a condition index.

fireweave.reasonCode.description: Backend condition/reason code (e.g. condition_match). Gated per ruling 11: emitted only together with fireweave.vendorFlagId, and only when the backend reported both a vendor flag id and a condition index.
